key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline was near-gold (construct decomposition first, instrument audit before reading any number, inline sensitivity bound), and the routed measurement pass now matches it first-class while closing the v5 AI's two gaps by contract: construct decomposition + instrument audit land in WHAT before any comparison (the non-routed v5 AI reached them only as a hypothesis in WHY), and sensitivity is priced at breakeven (B's clone share must fall from 55% to <= 26.7% — a 28-pp misspecification — to flip the verdict) plus ~12-sigma sampling gap instead of a terse note. Residual gap: clone shares are the instrumentation team's estimates (interested-party — B's designers benefit from B shipping); no independent verification channel exists in-scope, and the re-run is the only real fix.
learning_signal: Measurement precedes reading: before comparing any two numbers, audit the instrument's semantic fidelity — what event fires, under what trigger, whether it can fire without the construct — because a corrupted event inverts verdicts (naive +3 pp becomes corrected -10.2 pp) while the data stay identical. The routed m034 pass (operational definition with exact measure/instrument/units, P7 measurement-validity/Goodhart audit, measures-the-measurable-not-the-important check) makes this the first-class WHAT move, and the R4 m003 inversion gate generalizes it into a ranked enumeration of how the experiment could be made to ship the worse arm — the leakage is the top category, realized.
suggested_improvement: Keep dual-route m033+m034 first-class on signatures with undefined constructs + metric-driven decide/goals (P7 already hard-wired in WHY); extend the measurement-pass checklist with (a) a breakeven threshold — the parameter value at which the verdict flips, stated as distance from the reported estimate — and (b) an interested-party flag on instrument estimates (who built the instrument, who benefits from the verdict); attach the inversion gate's 'how the worse arm ships' category list as the instrument audit's test plan.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline defined the construct AS the contractual metric ('the construct for decision purposes is the claims-based rate'), verified the drop at ~5.5 standard errors, and recommended RENEW — the canonical measures-the-measurable-not-the-important failure — while the routed run caught it structurally: the R3-mandatory adversary pass enumerated the gaming vectors with quantified exposure (observation stays +500/yr, ER-return-without-admission +400/yr = 4.5x headroom for the 200 missing patients), the evidence-weighted SWOT graded the headline as strong evidence for the indicator but no evidence for the construct, and the de-gamed renewal plan (audit-based metric, frozen definition, guardrail caps, renegotiation) came out of the institution-design view. Residual gap: the audit CI (14.9-16.3) leaves up to ~1 pp of genuine improvement indistinguishable from zero, and the 6-month renegotiation window is the binding constraint.
learning_signal: When a metric is the explicit target of incentives, the metric is a map under attack — cases must go somewhere, so read the ledger's neighbors (observation stays, exclusions, definitional migrations) and triangulate with an instrument produced OUTSIDE the incentive path; a statistically overwhelming drop in an incentivized metric (5.5 SE) is a red flag, not evidence, when an independent instrument shows the construct flat. The adversary pass (R3 on adversarial signatures) makes leakage enumeration, capacity checking (missing cases vs substitution-channel headroom), and unconsulted-stakeholder listing mandatory rather than emergent, and the P7 audit must distinguish indicator-validity from construct-validity: a perfectly audited indicator can still measure the wrong thing.
suggested_improvement: Keep the R3 m019 gate on adversarial signatures with the quantified-exposure contract; add a mandatory capacity-check sub-step — count the missing cases and compare against the substitution channels' headroom before accepting any incentivized-metric drop; extend the P7 audit to output which instruments are produced outside the incentive path and record that split in the packet's provenance section; on adversarial signatures with metric-driven pay, pair the adversary pass with an institution-design view so the de-gamed alternative is priced, not just named.
